extractedItems.title: Who can put the ball back?
extractedItems.question: You're allowed to ask another player to mark and pick up your ball. Who must put the ball back in its place afterwards?

choices.text: The player only
The person who picked it up only
Either the player or the person who picked it up
Anyone watching

extractedItems.explanation: Either the person who picked up the ball or the player can put it back.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer on the putting green, asking a friend standing nearby to pick up and mark her golf ball.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teenage golfer asking another to mark her ball on the green.

extractedItems.title: Marking to the side to avoid another player's line
extractedItems.question: Your ball-marker is on another player's line on the green. What should you do?

choices.text: Leave it and play as normal
Mark the ball to the side by one or two putter head lengths
Move the ball anywhere you like
Mark it with a tee

extractedItems.explanation: You should mark the ball to the side by one or two putter head lengths to clear the other player's line.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy on the putting green, marking his ball to the side with his putter to avoid another player's line.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen golfer moving marker to the side to avoid a line on the green.

extractedItems.title: Accidentally moving the ball or marker while marking
extractedItems.question: If you accidentally move your ball or marker while marking, picking up, or replacing the ball, what should you do?

choices.text: Play from where it ends up
Leave it where it is
Put it back without penalty
Add a penalty stroke

extractedItems.explanation: If the ball or marker is moved accidentally while marking, picking up, or replacing the ball, you put it back without penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teen girl golfer on the green, accidentally nudging her ball while placing a marker, looking surprised.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Girl golfer accidentally moving her ball while marking.

extractedItems.title: What happens if the ball rolls away after being replaced?
extractedItems.question: After you've marked, picked up, and put your ball back on the green, it rolls away on its own. What do you do?

choices.text: Play it from the new spot
Put it back without penalty
Take a penalty stroke
Get disqualified

extractedItems.explanation: You must put the ball back on its original spot without penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage golfer kneeling on the green, watching her ball roll away after being replaced, looking unsure.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen golfer seeing her ball roll away after being replaced on the green.
